value_label: days until the next kaspa reward cut
headline:
bitcoin waits *601 days*.
kaspa cuts 19 times before then.

panes.title: WHAT CHANGES
lines: daily emission goes from 2.00 million to *1.89 million KAS*.
the block reward drops from 2.3125 to 2.1827 KAS. same arithmetic every month, no vote, no announcement.

note: the kaspa date is arithmetic, the bitcoin date is an estimate because it depends on how fast blocks are found.

post.x: the next kaspa reward cut lands in 11 days. bitcoin waits about 601 days for its next one, and kaspa cuts 19 more times before that date. daily emission drops from 2.00 million to 1.89 million KAS.
post.reply: the countdown runs live on kaspapulse.com/kaspa-halving.html
